description: Agent-runnable tasks with checkable success criteria. Run each task in a fresh session with only this skill installed.

tasks.prompt: Make the GapAnalyst phrase its clarification questions so each one names the source document it is questioning.
success_criteria: Edits the inline prompt in src/periop/agents/gap_analyst.py, not the ADK plumbing in src/periop/adk/
Leaves the JSON-Schema instruction block mechanism intact
Runs uv run pytest and the conformance tests, all passing
Smokes the change against the stub server before proposing any live run

tasks.prompt: Add a read-only API endpoint that returns the count of flagged claims per stage for a case.
success_criteria: Adds a route in src/periop/api/routers/ on the read side (no run lock)
Derives flagged status from claim status/citations consistent with the existing vocabulary
Adds or updates a test under tests/ and uv run pytest passes
Mentions the zod mirror (ui/src/lib/schema.ts) if the UI is to consume it

tasks.prompt: Our hosted endpoint is rate-limited; make claim verification run sequentially without code changes.
success_criteria: Answers with PERIOP_VERIFIER_CONCURRENCY=1 (or 0) as the env knob
Explains the default (4) and where the batching happens
